Trump administration promise tracker

29 officials in the Trump administration have promises published here, 63 in all. Every published promise carries sources from at least three distinct publishers, including at least one primary record. People are listed in the official order: the President, the Vice President, the heads of the executive departments in their legal order of succession, then other Cabinet-level officials and agency heads by last name.
